description: Runs one keyword research for a product: a Google-autocomplete sweep clustered by a model into intent groups with volume/difficulty estimates and prioritized content actions (Jev-scored fit/demand/competition when the TypeSafe key is bound). Spends one of the founder's monthly keyword-research runs — check first with get_keyword_ideas whether the stored research still serves. Requires a key with the rescan scope

seed.description: Seed keyword; defaults to the product's target keyword or name

name: run_keyword_research
